# `fixtures/` — what the mocks replay (Agent D)

`EXPO_PUBLIC_MOCK=1` runs the whole app from these files with no store, no walking, no camera
and no API keys (`01-SHARED-CONTRACTS.md` §12). The same installed build with the flag set is
the demo backup. Every file below says how it was produced, by whom and on which phone; the
replayers in `mocks/` never change when a synthetic file is replaced by a recording
(`06-INTEGRATION-AND-DEMO.md`, "chicken-and-egg").

**State today: everything is SYNTHETIC**, generated by `fixtures/tools/generate.mjs`
(`node fixtures/tools/generate.mjs` from the app root; deterministic, byte-identical on
re-run). Phase 0 replaces the crossing/store media, phase 2 replaces the perception packs and
the track with the module's own debug export from the demo phone.

| File | Contents | Produced by | Phone | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `track.json` | 1 Hz GPS (lat/lng/accuracy/course/speed), heading (`trueHeadingDeg` + accuracy tier), cumulative steps; `meta` (entrance, door time, accuracy snap, canyon jump, compass-2 stretch, curb, crossing, legs) and `phases` (jump-to-mode seek table) | `tools/generate.mjs` | none | synthetic — replace with a live-run recording in phase 2 |
| `perception/<pack>.jsonl` | one native event per line, `{"t": ms, "event": "onX", "payload": …}` (05 Part 1 line shape, 09 §10 export format); eight packs + one variant | `tools/generate.mjs` | none | synthetic — replace with the module's debug export |
| `perception/index.json` | `{ pack: rawJsonlText }` so Metro/Jest can import the packs | `tools/generate.mjs` | — | derived, regenerate with the packs |
| `frames/<seq>.jpg`, `frames/index.json` | stills returned by `snapshotJPEG`; `index.json` = `{ seq: { base64, width, height } }` | placeholder JPEGs | none | synthetic — replace with upright 512/640/1024 stills from the phone |
| `vision/<question>.json` | replies per `VisionQuestion`, keyed by `seq` with `"*"` default; hard cases: storefront confidence 0.3, malformed body, 4 s timeout, stale `seq`, `scan_left` unclear | hand-written | — | curated, keep |

## The track (`track.json`)

Home → right turn → signalized crossing (Forbes, bearing 180, 14 s curb dwell, aligned from
t=112) → far curb → along the storefront → pinned door at t=172 → 30 s indoors. Built to
exercise the **real** entry profile, not a convenient one:

- distance to the entrance falls under 15 m at the door, then freezes while GPS accuracy holds
  5–10 m, then **steps** to ~65 m at t=180 (not a climb); compass accuracy drops to 1 near
  the steel storefront; steps keep accumulating — the TransitionDetector fires 5–15 s after
  the door on this track, which is what the phone does live;
- one urban-canyon jump at t=30 (accuracy 38 m, 40 m off the line, a single fix) that must
  not advance a leg;
- a compass-accuracy-2 stretch on leg 2 (t=75–95, dead zone 18°);
- mid-crossing drift of 1.2 m to the right and back so COURSE is exercised on the crossing line.

`phases` maps every jump-to-mode target to a track second and a perception pack offset.

## Perception packs (`perception/*.jsonl`)

| Pack | Contains |
|---|---|
| `outdoor-leg` | pose at 10 Hz, `onLateralOffset {source:'pose'}` drifting to +0.7 m and back, one `onObstacleAhead MID`, tracking `NORMAL` |
| `curb-walk-onset` | `UNKNOWN` 6 s → `DONT_WALK` → `WALK fresh:true` (t=12 s) → `COUNTDOWN` → `DONT_WALK`; 0.5 Hz heartbeats; pose at 10 Hz facing the crossing, still until 13 s then walking it at 1.3 m/s (start / far-curb displacement rules) |
| `curb-walk-already-on` | first non-UNKNOWN state is `WALK fresh:false` |
| `curb-flicker` | 4-of-8 flicker that stays `UNKNOWN`; a `LIMITED` tracking gap; > 10 s of `UNKNOWN` (cant_see_signal path) |
| `vehicle-approach` | a parked-car track (constant area, never fires); one `onVehicleApproaching {RIGHT, growth 1.6}` then silence 4 s on that track; `onDetections` ≤ 5 Hz |
| `scan-unsignalized` | left and right scan windows with detections only, no `onVehicleApproaching` (SCAN_RESULT `none` path) |
| `scan-unsignalized-approach` | the variant that fires during the right scan |
| `indoor-aisle-walk` | `onOcrText` for aisles 1→3 at ≤ 3 Hz with 2-of-3 agreement, `onLateralOffset {source:'ocr_box'}`, one `onHazard PERSON_AHEAD`, `onDepth` closing at the end-of-aisle wall |
| `indoor-hard-cases` | a read matching nothing (`A1SLE 7Z`), two signs in one frame, two reads that skip 3 orders, reads with decreasing order (direction flip), 20 s with no read, **one deliberately malformed line** (the replayer must skip it, never crash) |

The replayer applies the 01 §7 rate limits on top, so a pack recorded before a native
rate-limit fix still reaches JS at the contractual rate.

## Recording the real thing (phase 0 / phase 2)

1. Perception: the module's debug export (09 §10) writes this exact line format; copy the
   files over the synthetic packs, keep the names, run `node fixtures/tools/generate.mjs
   --index-only` (or regenerate `perception/index.json` by hand) and `npm test` — the
   replayer tests assert each pack's required content.
2. Track: export the SensorService log from a live walk-up (1 Hz is enough), keep `meta` and
   `phases` (re-time `door.t` and the phase seconds to the recording).
3. Frames: `snapshotJPEG` stills from the phone at the seqs the vision fixtures reference.
4. Media: `video/` and `labels/` per the table above; raw video on the team drive.

Recorded on: _phone model, iOS version, capture format, date, by whom — fill in when the
first real file lands._
